scientific_integrity: Exact renewal-moment algebra and Laplace saddle asymptotic given with standalone quadrature and exact-event simulation checks; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two independent identical Brownian searchers on a half-line, irreversible absorption, instantaneous common Poisson resetting; asymptotic only for large d*sqrt(r/D). No multi-particle interaction or non-Poisson clocks. Broader implicit coverage remains possible.
title: Sharp decorrelation of two Brownian arrival times under a common reset clock
